tools.name: Word to PDF
tools.title: Word to PDF Converter Free Online | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Convert a .docx file into a PDF, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up, no watermark.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn a Word document into a PDF that looks the same everywhere it's opened — done locally in your browser, nothing uploaded.

faqs.q: Is my document uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. The conversion reads your .docx file and builds the PDF entirely in your browser using mammoth.js and pdf-lib — nothing is sent to a server.

faqs.q: Will formatting be preserved exactly?
faqs.a: This is a basic, text-focused converter: it lays out the extracted text as a PDF. Complex formatting, images, and page layout from the original .docx are not preserved.

faqs.q: Do I need Microsoft Word installed?
faqs.a: No. Everything runs in the browser tab — no Word, no other software required.

tools.name: PDF to JPG
tools.title: PDF to JPG Converter Free Online | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Convert every page of a PDF into a JPG image, free and browser-based. Download all pages as a ZIP.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn every page of a PDF into its own JPG image — useful for sharing a page as a picture, or pulling a document into a slide deck.

faqs.q: Do I get one image per page?
faqs.a: Yes. Every page is rendered as a separate JPG image, bundled together into a ZIP file for download.

faqs.q: Is the PDF uploaded to convert it?
faqs.a: No. Pages are rendered to images locally in your browser using pdf.js — nothing leaves your device.

faqs.q: What resolution are the JPGs?
faqs.a: Pages render at a resolution suited for on-screen viewing and sharing — not designed for large-format printing.

tools.name: JPG to PDF
tools.title: JPG to PDF Converter Free Online | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Combine one or more images into a single PDF file, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn one or more photos or scans into a single PDF — the order you add them is the order they appear in the document.

faqs.q: Can I combine multiple images into one PDF?
faqs.a: Yes. Add as many images as you like and they're combined into one PDF, one image per page, in the order you added them.

faqs.q: Which image formats are supported?
faqs.a: JPG and PNG images can be converted into a PDF.

faqs.q: Are my images uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. The PDF is built locally in your browser using pdf-lib — your images never leave your device.

tools.name: PDF to Excel
tools.title: PDF to Excel Converter Free Online | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF into rows and columns in a spreadsheet, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Pull tabular data out of a PDF and into a spreadsheet you can actually sort, filter, and calculate with.

faqs.q: Will tables convert perfectly?
faqs.a: The converter approximates table structure from text spacing and position — it works well for simple tables but won't perfectly reconstruct complex, merged-cell layouts.

faqs.q: What happens to pages with charts or scanned images?
faqs.a: Pages with little extractable text are embedded as images in the spreadsheet instead, so nothing is lost.

faqs.q: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Extraction and spreadsheet-building both happen locally in your browser.

tools.name: Excel to PDF
tools.title: Excel to PDF Converter Free Online | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Convert a spreadsheet's first sheet into a table PDF, free and browser-based. No upload, no sign-up.
tools.heroValueProp: Turn a spreadsheet into a PDF you can send to anyone, whether or not they have Excel installed.

faqs.q: Which file types can I convert?
faqs.a: XLSX, XLS, and CSV files can all be converted into a table-layout PDF.

faqs.q: Are multiple sheets and cell formatting preserved?
faqs.a: This is a basic converter: only the first sheet is converted, laid out as a simple table. Cell colors, fonts, and multi-sheet workbooks are not preserved.

faqs.q: Is my spreadsheet uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No. It's read and converted entirely in your browser.

tools.name: Sign PDF

tools.heroValueProp: Draw your signature with your mouse, finger, or stylus and drop it exactly where it needs to go on the document.

faqs.q: Is this a legally binding e-signature service?
faqs.a: No — this is a simple visual signature tool for adding a drawn signature to a document, not a certified e-signature platform with identity verification or audit trails.

faqs.q: Can I use a touchscreen or trackpad to sign?
faqs.a: Yes, the signature pad works with mouse, touchscreen, and stylus input.

faqs.q: Is my document uploaded to sign it?
faqs.a: No. The signature is drawn and placed onto the PDF entirely in your browser.

faqs.q: How do I change the page order?
faqs.a: Drag each page's thumbnail into the position you want before saving the reordered file.

faqs.q: Can I remove pages while reordering?
faqs.a: Reorder Pages keeps every page — use Delete Pages or Organize PDF if you also need to drop some pages while rearranging.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?

faqs.q: Does it apply to every page automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, the same header/footer text is stamped onto every page of the document in one step.

faqs.q: Will this make my PDF look like dark mode?
faqs.a: It inverts every page's colors into a negative palette, which gives a dark-background effect similar to dark mode, though results vary by document.

faqs.q: Does this work well on text-heavy documents?
faqs.a: It works best on simple text documents. Documents with photos or colored graphics will also have those colors inverted, which may look unusual.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?

tools.name: Flatten PDF
tools.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields Free Online | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Lock PDF form fields permanently into the page content, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Lock a filled-in form so the answers become part of the page itself and can no longer be edited or accidentally changed.

faqs.q: What does flattening actually do?
faqs.a: It converts any fillable form fields into permanent, non-editable page content — the visible values stay, but they can no longer be typed into or changed.

faqs.q: Should I flatten before or after filling a form?
faqs.a: Flatten after filling the form (see Fill PDF Form) once you're ready to lock the answers in.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, flattening happens locally using pdf-lib.

tools.name: Fill PDF Form
tools.title: Fill PDF Form Online Free | YOYOPDF
tools.description: Fill out fillable form fields in a PDF and save the result, free and browser-based.
tools.heroValueProp: Type directly into a PDF's existing form fields and save a completed copy — no printing, filling by hand, and rescanning.

faqs.q: Does this work on any PDF?
faqs.a: It works on PDFs that already contain fillable AcroForm fields. A plain scanned document with no form fields can't be filled this way.

faqs.q: Can I lock the answers in afterward?
faqs.a: Yes, use Flatten PDF after filling to make the entered values permanent and non-editable.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faqs.a: No, the form is filled entirely in your browser.
